subject: tool:gdl-memory-graph
value: A per-commit test suite may only be SKIPPED against the set of paths it was MEASURED to read, never against the directory it lives in. Measured for memory_graph/test_graph.py by instrumenting builtins.open / os.stat / os.scandir / os.listdir over a full run (2,164 distinct repository paths, 336 tests, 0 failures): memory_graph/records 1856, tools/gdl 277, memory_graph/inbox 13, memory_graph/legacy 3, config/GUNE5D 3, research/xbox_symbols 3, plus memory_graph/{core.py,gdlmem.py,schema.sql,schema/,test_graph.py}. Nothing under src/, include/, configure.py or AGENTS.md is read at all. Two of those roots are invisible to the intuitive 'did I touch a memory_graph file?' reading and both are live lanes' working files: every tools/gdl source is a graph BUILD input via core._iter_tool_source_paths (and the suite imports defake_gate.py and defake_rewrite.py directly), and config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json feeds law_corpus's pin-mechanism search. CALIBRATED over the last 60 commits on main: the measured discriminant skips 30 (50%); the intuitive one would skip 47, and 17 of those skips would be UNSOUND. The sound gate costs 0.59s against a 40.9s suite, so a skipped commit saves 40.3s and the 60-commit history saves ~20 minutes at zero soundness cost.
